summary: Timeboxed customer-data visibility check: temporary read-only prod log view + redaction certification
description: Request to provide a time-limited, audited read-only view into production logging for a targeted customer investigation. The access must include an automated redaction verification step and a certification from Privacy on the exported view before any slices leave the environment.
impact: Customer-reported unexpected content leakage in a small set of sessions. Investigation requires correlation of inference traces with ingress metadata. No broad customer-impacting outage; high compliance sensitivity.
request_details: Customer Support (CS) provided three session IDs that appear to contain user-provided PII in model outputs. CS requests a minimal, time-limited view for debugging (no raw exported payloads allowed until Privacy signs off). They also requested confirmation that any exported sample will have PII fields redacted and that a redaction verification checklist will be completed.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Query logging service for session IDs supplied by CS
2) Pull related inference trace entries with associated request metadata
3) Run redaction pass (PII token masking) using standard scrubbing pipeline
4) Attach redaction-verification report and send to Privacy for certification
logs: Log slice query: logs.prod.inference -> filter(session_id in [s-17a, s-23b, s-5c])
Sample trace ID: trace-20260308-9b3e -> contains user prompt and model output tokens
investigation_notes: Initial log pull returned 42 entries across three sessions. Two entries contain apparent email-like patterns in model output text.
No evidence of systemic leakage observed in sampling across other sessions for the same timeframe (query run using token-summarizer).
Hypothesis: a prompt template with unmasked variables caused user email to be echoed in a small percent of completions under low temperature settings.
Need Privacy to confirm redaction strategy before any export. SRE to provision read-only role with session-limited filter and audit hooks.
comments: Aisha Kumar (Support): Added initial log slice and identified candidate entries. /cc @privacy-team for sign-off
Priya Nair (Privacy): We need the redaction verification report and a clear justification of why raw payloads are required. Prefer anonymized diffs first.
Liam O'Connor (Oncall SRE): Will prepare time-limited role (ttl=24h) scoped to three session IDs and enable read-only access with audit logging. Will not allow bulk export until Privacy certifies.

Marco Diaz (Platform Eng): If redaction pipeline flags tokens with high PII probability, we should automatically mask and create a signed report. Referencing PR #9123 which adds a signed redaction manifest.
Aisha Kumar (Support): Customer OK with time-limited access as long as export is only after privacy sign-off.
resolution: (pending) Temporary read-only role created and audit hooks enabled. Redaction pipeline executed on candidate entries and produced a verification report. Privacy requested one more sample redaction iteration. No exports performed to date.
next_steps: 1) SRE to finalize TTL-limited role and post audit link in ticket (deadline: 2026-03-13)
2) Privacy to review redaction verification report and provide certification or additional redaction rules (deadline: 2026-03-14)
3) Support to coordinate with customer for limited review window once export is approved (if approved, export is stored encrypted and access logged)
4) If redaction fails, propose prompt-safe fallback and recommend rollout of a safe-template guardrail with the model config
final_notes: This ticket should remain open until Privacy certifies the redaction report and either (a) a sanitized export is delivered to CS under the agreed controls or (b) the investigation is closed with a documented rationale. Timebox for role is 24 hours from provisioning; extensions require explicit approval.
